ov: Large ocean predators with a spear-like bill and a long, rigid dorsal fin. The biggest, the Atlantic blue marlin and the black marlin, can reach 5 m and 670–820 kg. They are among the fastest fish, but popular speed claims are exaggerated. Blue and white marlins are endangered by overfishing.
len: Blue and black marlins: up to about 5 m
wt: Blue marlin up to 820 kg; black marlin up to 750 kg
rg: Warm open oceans; the blue marlin ranges from about 45°N to 35°S in the Atlantic.
fx: Marlins can change colour, lighting up their stripes just before they attack prey.
A female blue marlin can release over seven million eggs at once.
notes: RESOLVED (owner approved all suggestions, including the optional ones, 2026-09-29): Group entry. ANSWER CHECK (fact): "clocked at over 50 mph" is contradicted: blue marlin estimates "commonly go as high as 72 km/h" (45 mph), and a 2016 study put the black marlin's burst limit at 36 km/h (22 mph); reports of 80 mph are called exaggerated. Suggested wording: "Among the fastest fish, though the famous speed claims are exaggerated: likely under 45 mph."
